Read predictions and recordings from a pamDP data package

Source: R/read_pamdp.R
read_pamdp.Rd

Reads a data package in the pamDP format of pamflow (an adaptation of Camtrap DP to passive acoustic monitoring) and returns the machine predictions in the shape of read_selection_tables() and the list of recordings in the shape of list_recordings(), so that both can go to select_clips(), export_occupancy_data() and run_app().

Usage

read_pamdp(dir, site_column = "locationID", audio_root = NULL)

Arguments

dir

Folder of the data package.

site_column

Column of deployments.csv that names the site: "locationID" (default), "locationName" or "deploymentID". Deployments with this column empty take their deploymentID, with a message.

audio_root

Optional folder that relative filePath values are resolved against (e.g. the folder of the audio files on this computer). NULL keeps filePath as it is. Paths that are absolute or URLs are never changed.

Value

A list with two tibbles: predictions, one row per prediction, with site first, the columns required by select_clips() (begin_time, end_time, species_code, confidence, begin_path, file_offset) and observation_id, deployment_id, media_id, scientific_name, classified_by, low_freq and high_freq; and recordings, one row per audio file.

Details

A pamDP package holds three tables: deployments.csv (one row per recorder deployment, with its location), media.csv (one row per audio file) and observations.csv (one row per classified event, with the offsets eventStart and eventEnd in seconds from the start of the audio file). When the folder has a datapackage.json, the paths of the three tables are taken from its resources (deployments, media, observations); otherwise the files are looked for by those names.

Predictions. Observations of a classifier are kept: those with classificationMethod equal to "machine" (or empty) and a classificationProbability, of type "animal" when observationType is given, with a scientificName and a mediaID found in media.csv. Observations classified by people (classificationMethod = "human") are left out with a message: pamDP has no field that links a human classification to the prediction it checks, so they cannot be read as verdicts. The columns are mapped as follows:

pamDPsheepdog
classificationProbabilityconfidence
eventStart, eventEndbegin_time, end_time; file_offset = eventStart
filePath of the mediabegin_path
frequencyLow, frequencyHighlow_freq, high_freq
scientificNamespecies_code, see below
site_column of the deploymentsite

sheepdog names the folder of a species after the part of species_code after the last underscore, as in BirdNET labels ("Adenomera diptyx_ade-dip" gives ade_dip). The scientific name alone has no such part, so species_code is built as the scientific name and its lower-case, hyphenated form: "Boana raniceps" becomes "Boana raniceps_boana-raniceps", whose folder is boana_raniceps.

Recordings. Every row of media.csv is a recording, including the ones without any prediction, which the occasions of the occupancy models and "random_recordings" need. The table has site and source_audio (the same path as begin_path), as list_recordings() does, plus media_id, deployment_id, timestamp and file_length (seconds).

Dates and hours. sheepdog takes the date and hour of a recording from its file name (YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS), not from the timestamp of media.csv. The files whose names do not carry them are reported; rename them, or the nights and hours of the occasions will be missing.

References

Betancourt, N., Toro-Gómez, M., Cañas, J., Barona-Cortés, E., et al. (2026). pamflow: an open-source workflow for simplified passive acoustic monitoring data analysis. Methods in Ecology and Evolution. doi:10.1111/2041-210x.70432

Bubnicki, J. W., Norton, B., Baskauf, S. J., Bruce, T., et al. (2024). Camtrap DP: an open standard for the FAIR exchange and archiving of camera trap data. Remote Sensing in Ecology and Conservation, 10(3), 283-295. doi:10.1002/rse2.374

See also

read_selection_tables(), list_recordings(), vignette("organising-data").

Examples

dp <- file.path(tempdir(), "pamdp")
dir.create(dp, showWarnings = FALSE)
utils::write.csv(data.frame(
  deploymentID = c("d1", "d2"), locationID = c("ARA", "BAI"),
  latitude = -20, longitude = -54,
  deploymentStart = "2021-10-01T18:00:00-04:00",
  deploymentEnd = "2021-10-02T06:00:00-04:00"),
  file.path(dp, "deployments.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
utils::write.csv(data.frame(
  mediaID = c("m1", "m2", "m3"), deploymentID = c("d1", "d1", "d2"),
  timestamp = "2021-10-01T19:00:00-04:00",
  filePath = c("ARA/ARA01_20211001_190000.wav",
               "ARA/ARA01_20211001_200000.wav",
               "BAI/BAI01_20211001_190000.wav"),
  filePublic = FALSE, fileMediatype = "audio/wav", sampleRate = 48000,
  bitDepth = 16, fileLength = 60, numChannels = 1),
  file.path(dp, "media.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
utils::write.csv(data.frame(
  observationID = c("o1", "o2", "o3"), deploymentID = c("d1", "d1", "d2"),
  mediaID = c("m1", "m1", "m3"), eventStart = c(3, 12, 30),
  eventEnd = c(6, 15, 33), observationLevel = "event",
  observationType = "animal", scientificName = "Boana raniceps",
  classificationMethod = "machine", classifiedBy = "BirdNET 2.4",
  classificationProbability = c(0.91, 0.42, 0.77)),
  file.path(dp, "observations.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
pam <- read_pamdp(dp, audio_root = "/Volumes/NAS/audio")
#> 3 predictions of 1 species read from 2 site(s); 3 recordings.
pam$predictions
#> # A tibble: 3 × 14
#>   site  begin_time end_time low_freq high_freq species_code           confidence
#>   <chr>      <dbl>    <dbl>    <dbl>     <dbl> <chr>                       <dbl>
#> 1 ARA            3        6       NA        NA Boana raniceps_boana-…       0.91
#> 2 ARA           12       15       NA        NA Boana raniceps_boana-…       0.42
#> 3 BAI           30       33       NA        NA Boana raniceps_boana-…       0.77
#> # ℹ 7 more variables: begin_path <chr>, file_offset <dbl>,
#> #   observation_id <chr>, deployment_id <chr>, media_id <chr>,
#> #   scientific_name <chr>, classified_by <chr>
pam$recordings
#> # A tibble: 3 × 6
#>   site  source_audio                media_id deployment_id timestamp file_length
#>   <chr> <chr>                       <chr>    <chr>         <chr>           <dbl>
#> 1 ARA   /Volumes/NAS/audio/ARA/ARA… m1       d1            2021-10-…          60
#> 2 ARA   /Volumes/NAS/audio/ARA/ARA… m2       d1            2021-10-…          60
#> 3 BAI   /Volumes/NAS/audio/BAI/BAI… m3       d2            2021-10-…          60
